review.decision: Preserve failed instruction coverage and rearm only after a proven zero submission
review.notes: The independent sixth review identified an enabled journal outage and a final pre-submit refusal. Exercise restart and a fresh authorization on the original action, retaining actual refusal evidence and preventing uncertain or prior transport replays.

cases.description: An enabled journal admission failure durably invalidates old authority; only a proven unsent action can accept fresh authorization after refusal.
cases.setup: Isolated exact-target workspace, journal with unchanged enabled policy, saved action and real filesystem failure, synthetic native input.
cases.action: Lose a target prompt when the sequence is read-only, restore the counter and append an ordinary event. Refuse the last gate, reopen the workspace, re-review the same and fresh sources, and repeat the pump. Also return an unknown response or accepted transport.
cases.expected: Old direct and workspace authority cannot cross the enabled outage. A fresh explicit instruction can recover. A durable zero-submission receipt survives recovery and only a later authority can drive the original ID once. Unknown, prior, and submitted attempts remain reserved for reconciliation.
